name: Moddy Arena
intro: Welcome to Moddy Arena! You are in the prep room. The arena is past the gate.
Get ready in the prep room: make things, then put them on your hotbar. Open one in My wishes and press Add to hotbar.

The battle arena control panel is on the wall: pick the monsters, the difficulty and the waves, then press START BATTLE. In a battle, only the wishes on your hotbar work, and you have 3 lives. The Champions board is on the back wall.
_notes: The world's manifest, as its jar ships it: gameplay only (no hostnames, ports, machines or briefs). intro: the first-join words, said once per player per world by the core a few seconds after he arrives in the prep room.
